title: BKM x BCA Mahjong Tile Set
description: In honor of Breast Cancer Alliance’s 30th anniversary, Brooklyn Mahjong has collaborated with BCA to create an exclusive, limited-edition mahjong set celebrating three decades of progress, hope, and impact. For three decades, BCA has advanced innovative breast cancer research, trained the next generation of breast surgeons, and expanded access to lifesaving breast cancer screening and diagnostic services for underserved patients. This special collaboration celebrates the timeless game of Mahjong alongside exquisite design and craftsmanship in support of BCA’s mission to improve survival and quality of life for those impacted by breast cancer through prevention, early detection, treatment, and finding a cure. A portion of the proceeds from each limited-edition set will benefit BCA and help advance this vital work. description: Brooklyn Mahjong and Alexandra Kaehler's limited-edition mahjong tile set is the result of a shared design ethos: great design is timeless, unexpected, and unapologetically personal. We both believe refined beauty doesn't have to be boring, sophistication doesn't need to be serious, and the items we live with should be loved and used. Alex's design process is rooted in intimacy and built from an understanding of what matters to her clients. She translates that into spaces layered with unexpected colors, patterns, textures, and objects. That same intentionality shaped this limited-edition tile set + mat. The result is a collection that's entirely its own: an unexpected color palette that feels both timeless and contemporary, that is studded with personal touches: the birth flowers of Alex's three children, a nod to her husband's love of fishing, and traces of her home's botanical gardens. title: Clear Back Kindle Case (11th Generation) Basic - 6” Display
tags: book, book-lover, bookish, booktok, clear-back, clear-back-kindle-case, ereader, fits-colorsoft, floral-filigree, kindle, kindle-case
description: These clear back cases are the most customizable way to protect your Kindle. Each case includes a removable cover that attaches to the back of the case via a magnetic ring. When closed, magnets hold the cover tight, protecting your Kindle. When open, you can fold the cover into a stand to hold your device up for hands-free reading! Or, remove the cover all together and attach a pop socket for easy, one-hand holding. The clear back of the case allows you to showcase your own personality with a custom design or your favorite vinyl stickers. And since the cover is so easily removable, you can mix and match covers with a simple snap! Choose from three different model sizes and more than a dozen patterns to help express your style, mood and even what you’re reading. Floral Filigree is an artist-designed chintz flower pattern with swirling leaves featuring blue, green, burnt orange and pink accents. BEFORE YOU ORDER, PLEASE double check your Kindle Model! *These cases do NOT fit any Kindle models released in October 2026* Device Type can be found by swiping down from the top of your Kindle screen. Selecting “All Settings”, then “Device Options”, then ”Device Info”. Look to “Device Type” then select your Device Type from our drop down menu! If you have an 11th Generation device please DOUBLE CHECK if it is a PAPERWHITE OR BASIC, we carry both size cases. If your Device Type is not listed, we do not carry cases that will fit your device. Available in three sizes for these EXACT models: -Kindle Basic (11th generation) -Kindle Paperwhite (11th generation) -Kindle Colorsoft (1st generation) and Paperwhite (12th generation) More help identifying your Kindle Device Type

description: These clear back cases are the most customizable way to protect your Kindle. Each case includes a removable cover that attaches to the back of the case via a magnetic ring. Or, remove the cover all together and attach a pop socket for easy, one-hand holding. The clear back of the case allows you to showcase your own personality with a custom design or your favorite vinyl stickers. And since the cover is so easily removable, you can mix and match covers with a simple snap! Choose from three different model sizes and more than a dozen patterns to help express your style, mood and even what you’re reading. Strawberry Patch is an artist-designed floral repeating pattern inspired by fresh fruit, berry picking, and the Farmer’s Market. BEFORE YOU ORDER, PLEASE double check your Kindle Model! *These cases do NOT fit any Kindle models released in October 2026* Device Type can be found by swiping down from the top of your Kindle screen. Selecting “All Settings”, then “Device Options”, then ”Device Info”. Look to “Device Type” then select your Device Type from our drop down menu! If you have an 11th Generation device please DOUBLE CHECK if it is a PAPERWHITE OR BASIC, we carry both size cases. If your Device Type is not listed, we do not carry cases that will fit your device. Available in three sizes for these EXACT models: -Kindle Basic (11th generation) -Kindle Paperwhite (11th generation) -Kindle Colorsoft (1st generation) and Paperwhite (12th generation) More help identifying your Kindle Device Type

description: Our neoprene drink sleeves are designed to keep your favorite beverages comfortable to hold while adding a fun, stylish touch to your daily coffee run. They also provide an extra layer of insulation to help keep hot drinks warmer for longer. Available in multiple sizes to fit a variety of cups, tumblers, and coffee orders, these sleeves combine everyday functionality with artist-designed patterns you'll love to show off. Lightweight, reusable, and easy to slip on and off, they're the perfect accessory for coffee lovers, commuters, students, and anyone who enjoys their drinks on the go. Primrose Petals is an artist-designed warm tone, watercolor floral pattern featuring wildflowers and marigolds on a pink background. Compatible with all standard sized ice cream pint containers

description: Our neoprene drink sleeves are designed to keep your favorite beverages comfortable to hold while adding a fun, stylish touch to your daily coffee run. Made from insulating neoprene, they help absorb condensation from cold drinks to keep your hands dry and reduce moisture on desks, car cup holders, and countertops. They also provide an extra layer of insulation to help keep hot drinks warmer for longer. Available in multiple sizes to fit a variety of cups, tumblers, and coffee orders, these sleeves combine everyday functionality with artist-designed patterns you'll love to show off. Lightweight, reusable, and easy to slip on and off, they're the perfect accessory for coffee lovers, commuters, students, and anyone who enjoys their drinks on the go. Cowgirl Boots is an artist-designed floral repeating pattern inspired by cowboy romance novels, bachelorette trips, Nashville and the wild west. In a delft style, the navy, baby blue, and white color pallet is perfect for both Booktok and line dancing lovers. Compatible with all 12 oz slim cans

title: Measuring Tape Keychain
tags: pressed-floral
description: Whether you're crafting, comparing clothing sizes or trying to see if that new furniture will fit - this one keychain will make it all easier! The Elyse Breanne Design measuring tape keychain is meant to move with you. Each one includes a gold swivel lobster clasp so you can clip it onto your bag, your belt loop or even your keys. With a case measuring just 2.25" across, this keychain is lightweight enough to go unnoticed, and each one has an invisible retract release button on the side. Each measure is wrapped in our beautiful and durable vegan mushroom leather, and you can choose from 11 different patterns! Consider it the perfect gift for the sewers, quilters, crafters and designers - or anyone who could use a little extra ease in their life! Pressed Floral is an artist-designed repeating pattern featuring line-drawn pressed wildflowers and botanicals with a cream and black color pallet.

title: Hip Hip Hanukkah Mahjong Mat
tags: Mahjong Mat

We envision you dressed to the 9s, eating latkes, laughing and exchanging gifts while hosting all of your favorite people! title: Bird Bam Hat
tags: accessories, hat
description: Our navy blue hat features pink stitching, a pink top button, rich 3D bubble embroidered chartreuse letters that celebrate everyone’s favorite social tile the one bird bam. Around here we like to say “One Bam, Thank You Ma’am!” then toast! Rock this at your next Mahj game and start your own one bam craze!

title: One Bam Mahjong Hoodie
tags: accessories
description: Show off your love of mahjong in the One Bam Mahjong Hoodie. This high-quality hot pink hoodie features an embroidered One Bam tile from Hip Hip Mahjong’s The House Collection on the left chest, with the Hip Hip Mahjong logo for a signature finishing touch. Cozy, colorful, and made for mahjong lovers on and off the table. The neck line offers a classic slit opening. So soft and cozy. It’s ready to mahj all day & night. Measurements under details.

title: Dice Bag
tags: accessories
description: Keep your mahjong dice together in this compact Hip Hip Mahjong Dice Bag. Featuring an embossed Hip Hip Mahjong logo, it’s an easy way to store dice and other small mahjong accessories between games. It also works perfectly as a small coin or accessory bag.

title: Birthday Mahjong Mat
tags: Mahjong Mat
description: Happy Birthday to All of Us! The mat everyone’s been waiting for. This mat is sure to make your Birthday Mahj extra special. Bright birthday colors featured throughout the mat, with a Charleston refresher on a cake in every corner. A mat your Mahjong group will surely wonder how they ever celebrated without! Birthday Mahj has now become your favorite Mahjong of the year! This also makes a perfect birthday gift for your Mahjong Crazed friend!

title: Celebration Mahjong Mat
tags: Mahjong Mat
description: Wine, Dine & Mahj at your next Dinner Party with our Celebration Mahjong Mat. This mat is ready to take your Mahjong game to the next level. title: Rackin' Rudolph Mahjong Mat!
tags: Mahjong Mat

This will surely have your eyes all a glow…finding it hard to sleep tonight, because naturally you’ll want to Mahj! Each player is offered a Charleston refresher written simplistically on the mat.

title: Celebration Tiles
tags: Mahj Tiles
description: Acrylic hand-painted tiles finished with metallic paint and created for life’s most celebratory moments. If tiles could wear a tuxedo, these would. A classic ivory face meets a rich black pearl back, with clear and pearl acrylic marbled through the sides for a dimensional finish worthy of a black-tie affair. Stars shine across the dots, streamers dance through the bams, disco balls take over the winds, champagne jokers pop the bubbly, cocktail dragons raise a glass, and night-out essentials dress up the flowers. title: Birthday Mahjong Tiles
tags: Mahj Tiles
description: Happy Birthday to All of Us! Bring the celebration to the table with Birthday Mahjong Tiles. Made from three layers of acrylic in white, pink, and yellow, this cheerful set brings bold birthday color to every game. Each tile features original Hip Hip Mahjong artwork, individually engraved and hand-painted to bring every detail to life. Perfect for birthday celebrations, Mahj nights with your favorite people, or as a special gift for the Mahjong lover in your life.

title: Rack Star Hat
description: Our pink hat features royal blue stitching, a pink top button, rich 3D bubble embroidered royal blue letters with the phrase “Rack Star”. Man, I feel just like a Rack Star when I wear this hat, and so will You!

title: Tile Icon Hat
description: Our white hat features pink stitching, a pink top button, rich 3D bubble embroidered bubble gum with the phrase “Tile Icon”. You’re iconic & you know it. Now your Mahj group will know it too. Let’s show those tiles whose boss!

title: Mahjionaire Hat
description: Our baby blue hat features navy stitching, a baby blue top button, rich 3D bubble embroidered navy letters showing everyone at the table whose money bag weighs the most! You’re a Mahjionaire, and you know it!

title: Rackin’ Rudolph Tiles
tags: Mahj Tiles
description: Acrylic engraved and hand-painted tiles, with a thoughtful design to spread Holiday Cheer to you & your Mahjong group! This American Mahjong set includes 160 tiles, each measuring 24 × 34 × 16 mm. Rudolph certainly has had his fair share of the limelight and these tiles will too! This collection takes center stage with a 3 layer tile in winter green, Rudolph red and white snow. Each tile shows off cheery images telling a festive story each time you play! But what truly makes this set glow are the bams: 1–9 build a Rudolph! Symbolizing the inner struggles we all face, letting go of the judgement from others, our need for approval, learning to accept ourselves for who we are created to be and ultimately shining our light. May we all love our inner Rudolph despite what people say, think or do to us!

title: The House Tiles
tags: Mahj Tiles

title: The House Mahjong Mat
tags: Mahjong Mat

title: The Basketweave Racks

description: The Basketweave Racks pair the warmth of hand-woven cane with the clarity of acrylic. This is a natural characteristic of real cane, not a defect. We're working closely with our manufacturer to keep this as minimal as possible, and a little natural variation is part of what makes each set one of a kind. A timeless blend of classic craftsmanship and modern materials, designed to be as beautiful on display as it is around the table.

description: For $150.00 a month, our locals will have access to unlimited open play on our regular and electronic tables. description: League play is for players who feel confident with the rules of the game and are ready for fun competition. title: Mahjong 101
description: Curious about American Mahjong but don't know where to start? Mahjong 101 is a fun, beginner-friendly introduction to the game. Learn the Basics & Start Playing! You'll learn the tiles, how to read the NMJL card, the basics of building a hand, calling and exposing tiles, jokers, and how a game flows from start to finish. This is a hands-on class , so you'll learn the basics and then put them into practice with guided play. Snacks and drinks will be provided! Perfect for: Complete beginners or anyone who wants a Mahjong refresher.

title: Mahjong 102
description: Ready to take your Mahjong game to the next level? Mahjong 102 dives deeper into the strategy behind American Mahjong. Go Beyond the Basics! You'll learn how to navigate the Charleston, recognize potential hands, choose and change strategies, make smarter discards, use jokers effectively, and read what other players are doing at the table. This is a hands-on, strategy-focused class designed to help you play with greater confidence and intention. Snacks and drinks will be provided! Perfect for: Players who know the basics and are ready to improve their game. *Mahjong 101 or equivalent experience required.

title: Beach Mahj Lesson- Mahjong 101

This is a hands-on class , so you'll learn the basics and then put them into practice with guided play. Snacks and drinks will be provided! Perfect for: Complete beginners or anyone who wants a Mahjong refresher.

description: The Rodeo Mahjong Mat A little cowgirl spirit, a lot of pink personality. The Rodeo frames a soft blush playing field with galloping horses, lasso-twirling cowgirls, desert mountains, and heart-topped cacti. Galloping horses, cowgirls, desert mountains, and heart-topped cacti bring a playful Western story to the blush-colored artwork. Rope-inspired framing and ruby stars tie the scene together, giving the open playing field a coordinated, vintage-inspired finish. An original Mahjong by SI™ design, The Rodeo is a thoughtful choice for game nights, gathering with friends, and gifting to a fellow mahjong lover. Why You Will Love It Original Mahjong by SI™ design Illustrated horses, cowgirls, mountains, and heart-topped cacti A soft blush playing field with plenty of pink personality Rope-inspired borders and ruby star details A playful Western choice for cowgirl gatherings and gifting Smooth 3MM neoprene surface for effortless tile movement Cushioned construction for a quieter, more comfortable game Beautiful for gatherings, gifting, and everyday play Durable stitched edge for long-lasting quality Easy to roll, store, and travel with Printed in the USA Details Dimensions: Available in 20" x 20", 31.5" x 31.5", and 33.5" x 33.5" Material: Smooth 3MM neoprene with a stitched border Storage The mat arrives rolled and packaged in a protective plastic bag for convenient storage and transportation. The border may not lay completely flat when first unrolled, but it will typically relax and flatten with regular use. Please Note Because each mat is printed, slight color variations may occur during the production process. Colors may also appear slightly different in person due to screen settings, lighting, and edited photography.

description: Whether you’re an American Mah Jongg newbie or an intermediate player looking to gain an edge over your opponents, American Mah Jongg for Everyone is the perfect book to help you start practicing your game! Experienced international Mah Jongg instructors Gregg Swain and Toby Salk walk you through the basics of American Mah Jongg–introducing readers to the tiles, rituals, history, rules and winning strategies of the game. This book comes with everything you need to get started playing, including: A timeless sample Mah Jongg scoring card A paper set to cut out and use while learning Easy-to-follow, step-by-step instructions Over 80 color illustrations Helpful practice exercises and quizzes that reinforce the lessons Access to a website that provides up to date information about the game A glossary of terms that every Mah Jongg player needs to know From the many different types of tiles and how to recognize them, personal stories about the game and historical trivia, American Mah Jongg for Everyone has something for anyone interested in this fascinating game.

tags: Books, Cards and Learning Tools, Gifts For $25 and Under
description: Join Fern and a colorful cast of characters in her debut memoir titled Mah Jongg Mondays. Fern, married and the mother of three boys takes us into her modern middle-class suburban Long Island world where one day she gets the “Big Idea” to learn the Chinese tile game called mah jongg. Weekly games provide the setting for deep-seeded friendships to form around the mah jongg table. These Monday gatherings become a source of support and strength for Fern as her husband is diagnosed with cancer. Fear, insecurity and potential heart-wrenching loss become challenges she must overcome. The author weaves the themes of destiny, faith, friendship, time and love throughout the story. title: Mah Jongg: The Art of the Game: A Collector’s Guide to Mah Jongg Tiles and Set. (Hardcover)
tags: Books, Cards and Learning Tools, Gifts For $25 and Under
description: “I thoroughly enjoyed this book. Whether used as a reference or a beautiful keepsake, it’s a very worthy addition to the world of Mah Jongg.” –Ruth Unger, President, National Mah Jongg League **Great coffee table book and Gift*** This is the first book to fully capture the story of the exotic and exciting game of Mahjong or “Mah Jongg,” offering an intimate look at the history of the game as well as the visual beauty of the tiles. When authors Ann Israel and Gregg Swain began playing Mahjong, they were unaware of the vintage collections that existed not only in the United States but also across the globe. Slowly, they started to collect their own sets of Mahjong and as their collections grew, so did their appreciation of the history of, and interest in, the game. Finding few references, Israel and Swain set out to create a book that chronicles the early beginnings of the game and documents Mahjong sets from the most basic, made of paper, to the most precious materials such as ivory and mother-of-pearl. Recognized and respected scholars and game experts have collaborated with Israel and Swain, contributing essential chapters on the game’s history and its pieces as well as technical information on the tiles. Lastly, prominent collectors from around the globe have shared their incredible sets and memories for the first time in one book for everyone to enjoy. With hundreds of beautiful new images by renowned photographer Michel Arnaud, and including historical documentation and ephemera, Mah Jongg: The Art of the Game fills the void between the past’s and today’s game, providing vision, inspiration and resources. Anyone who has ever been intrigued by a Mahjong tile will find in these pages visually stunning photographs that will entice them into becoming an enthusiast of the timeless game of Mahjong.

title: Butterfly Raised Dice Dish
description: The Butterfly Raised Dice Dish sits on a tall pedestal base that lifts it above the table. Inside, the white Arita ware porcelain is decorated with butterflies, some outlined in red and others painted in deep blue. They surround a small flower at the center, with green sprigs between them and red blossoms along the rim. Vertical stripes of blue, orange, mauve, and pale yellow wrap the base and stand out against the plain white outer wall.

title: Pine Dice Dish
tags: Dice holder
description: The Pine Dice bowl features a soft three-lobed shape inspired by the silhouette of a pine tree, a traditional Japanese motif that symbolizes longevity and resilience. The interior is delicately decorated with hand-painted green and gold pine leaf patterns that shimmer softly against the pale blue glaze.

title: Geometric Tortoise Shell Dice Dish
tags: Dice holder
description: The Geometric Tortoise Shell Dice Dish is decorated with a traditional tortoise-shell pattern, a hexagonal design modeled on the segments of a tortoise's back. In Japan, the tortoise is a symbol of long life, and the pattern has been used for centuries as a sign of good fortune. Here, the hexagons cover the whole surface of a small dish in a traditional Japanese lobed oval shape. Painted by hand on white Arita ware porcelain, broad bands of deep blue link the hexagons, with darker dots where the bands meet.

title: Plum Dice Dish
tags: Dice holder
description: Shaped like a blooming plum blossom, the Plum Condiment Bowl reflects the refined artistry of Arita ware. Each of the five softly curved petals is adorned with alternating vermilion and white panels, accented by circular gold detailing and a small floral motif at the center. Plum blossoms open in late winter, and the design brings that early-spring color to the table. Crafted from glossy white porcelain by Tokko Kiln, an Arita kiln founded in 1865, this piece is ideal for keeping your dice in style.

title: Golden Drake Dice Dish
description: The Golden Drake Dice Dish is shaped like a mandarin duck, a bird traditionally associated in Japan with harmony and good fortune. Crafted in Arita, by Shobido Honten, the male duck features vivid red, green, turquoise, and lavender accents, complemented by delicate touches of gold. The detailed decoration brings out the distinctive form of the bird while showcasing the character of Japanese porcelain. Lift the duck-shaped lid to reveal a petite pear-shaped bowl inside.

title: Plum on Blue Octagon Dice Dish
tags: Dice holder
description: The Plum on Blue Octagon Dice Dish sets white plum blossoms against a vivid cobalt blue ground. Painted by hand at Yozan Kiln, the blossoms are outlined in soft red with fine red stamens, and a ring of them circles the dish near the rim. Fine white lines run parallel to each edge, so the stripes form nested octagons around the center, and white creases mark the folds between the eight panels. Made of glossy Hizen Yoshida ware porcelain, the eight-sided dish has a gently sloped interior to keep your dice in the center.

title: Lattice Circle Dice Dish
tags: Dice holder
description: The Lattice Circle Lidded Dice Dish features alternating green and purple striped circles on a white porcelain surface. Its rounded form and fitted lid keeps contents safe, while the geometric pattern adds a distinctive decorative detail to the bowl. Made in Arita Ware, it combines a compact form with a decorative design.

title: Turtle Dice Dish
tags: Dice holder
description: The Turtle Dice Bowl celebrates one of Japan’s most enduring symbols of longevity and good fortune. In folklore, the turtle is believed to bring blessings of a long and prosperous life, making it a cherished motif in traditional art and tableware. Made in Arita Ware by Tokko Kiln, this petite porcelain bowl gives that classic symbol a playful, modern look.

title: Persimmon Lidded Dice Dish
tags: Dice holder
description: The Persimmon Lidded Dice Bowl brings the warm color and rounded shape of a ripe autumn persimmon to the table. Its glossy orange body is topped with a textured, tan and brown stem cap that lifts off by its small stem. This compact bowl has a lifelike, playful look. Lift the lid to reveal a smooth interior.

title: Floral Blossom Octagon Dice Dish
description: The Floral Blossom Octagon Dice Dish features a traditional Japanese floral motif in warm shades of burnt orange, soft red, and gold. The blossoms are hand-painted in four panels on alternating sides of the eight-sided dish, each framed by a thin blue line and curling arabesque scrolls. Small red lattice patterns fill the sides between the panels.

title: Lantern Plant Lidded Dice Dish
description: The Lantern Plant Lidded Dice Dish looks just like a freshly picked hōzuki, its vivid orange surface shaped with lifelike detail. It adds a touch of whimsy to the table and is sure to spark conversation. In Japan, the lantern plant is a familiar sign of summer, sold at seasonal hōzuki markets and used in decorations for Obon. Crafted in Arita ware porcelain, the bowl captures this charm with a glossy orange glaze on the outside and a warm white interior that highlights whatever you place inside.

title: Golden Hen Dice Dish
description: The Golden Hen Dice Dish by Shobido Honten is shaped like a female mandarin duck, traditionally associated in Japan with fidelity and harmony. Crafted in Arita, the porcelain figure features vivid red, green, turquoise, and lavender accents with delicate touches of gold. The detailed painting highlights the feathers and facial features, emphasizing the sculptural form of the bird. Lift the duck-shaped lid to reveal a petite pear-shaped bowl inside.

title: Bellflower Radiant Dice Dish
description: Scalloped edges and vivid reds, blues, greens, and yellows give the Bellflower Radiant Dice Dish a bold look inspired by the ornate brocade patterns of Ko-Imari. Panels of wave, lattice, and other traditional designs radiate around the rim, interrupted on each side by a floral cartouche. At the white center, a pomegranate motif symbolizes prosperity and abundance. Made of Arita ware porcelain, this Japanese sauce dish comes from Shobido in Arita, Saga Prefecture.

title: Midi Card
description: Not quite Mini Mahjer anymore, not quite NMJL yet. The Midi Mahjer Card is exactly where you need to be. You crushed the Mini Mahjer Card. You're not ready to tackle the full NMJL Card. The Midi Card adds three new sections (The Year, Quintets, and Singles & Pairs), bumps you up to ~45 line options, and introduces two game-changing concepts: Points and Concealed Hands. It's more complex, more strategic, and a whole lot more satisfying. But don't worry — we didn't forget you're still learning. The Midi keeps Mini Mahjer's signature visual style: easy-to-read colors, larger print, helpful icons, line examples, and highlighted Concealed Hands so nothing surprises you. Patterns are still 12 tiles long (not NMJL's 14), and every feature is designed to build your confidence. The Midi Mahjer Card. More than Mini. Less than NMJL. Exactly right.

title: Athens Riviera Coffee Table Book by Assouline
description: Overlooking the Aegean Sea, a charming string of coastal neighborhoods form the Athens Riviera, a serene escape from the constant activity in the city’s center. A selection of high-end hotels lines the pristine stretch of beaches down to the southernmost point of the Attica Peninsula. The revamped Four Seasons Astir Palace, with a history of housing foreign dignitaries and film stars of the 1960s, is the most luxurious hotel in Athens, perhaps even in all of Greece. The night club, Island, is bringing back the glamour and excitement of the twentieth century bouzouki clubs reminiscent of names such as Melina Mercouri and Stavros Niarchos. Athens is experiencing a revival—in art, night life and design. For a metropolis constantly associated with the past, the modern strides in development and culture are sometimes overlooked in favor of the ruins and artifacts from antiquity. When in fact, the juxtaposition only enhances the beauty of both. Athens Riviera puts the old-world beside the new-world and a deeper understanding of this ancient capital emerges. With one foot in the past and one foot in the future; access to both the electricity of city life and the tranquility of a beach side resort, Athens cannot be defined in simple terms. Experience the beauty of Villa d'Este, Passalacqua, and Villa del Balbianello with their lush gardens and fragrant greenery. Enjoy scenic walks, lazy lakeside days, and luxurious boat rides across the sparkling water. Lake Como Idyll is a travel coffee table book that promises a magical Italian getaway full of romance, charm, and breathtaking landscapes. title: Palm Beach Coffee Table Book by Assouline
description: Early in the 1900s, one-time oil baron Henry Morrison Flagler took interest in the Southern coast of Florida and began developing an exclusive resort community. Establishing a railroad that would allow easier access to the area, he went on to build two hotels—his hope was that America’s first families would come to populate the area. This modest community would later evolve into an iconic American destination , hosting British royalty, American movie stars, and becoming the home-away-from-home to some of the country’s leading families. As the century continued, Palm Beach established itself as a luxury hideaway synonymous with old-world glamour and new-world sophistication. In this splendid travel coffee table book , longtime resident and Palm Beach social fixture Aerin Lauder takes us through her Palm Beach. From favorite restaurants like Nandos and Renatos, to favorite houses like La Follia and Villa Artemis, she takes us to the elite shopping of Worth Avenue and the scenic walkways of the Lake Worth trail, all the while relating to us the histories, faces, and places that have become so identified with Palm Beach. title: Ibiza Bohemia Coffee Table Book by Assouline
description: From roaring nightlife to peaceful yoga retreats, Ibiza’s hippie-chic atmosphere is its hallmark. This quintessential Mediterranean hot spot in Spain has served as an escape for artists, creatives, and musicians alike for decades. It is a place to reinvent oneself, to walk the fine line between civilization and wilderness, and to discover bliss. Ibiza Bohemia is a travel coffee table book that explores the island’s scenic Balearic cliffs, its legendary cast of characters, and the archetypal interiors that define its signature style. title: Comporta Bliss Coffee Table Book by Assouline
description: Sometimes compared to the Saint-Tropez of Brigitte Bardot in the 1950s, Comporta, with its relaxed pace and artistic community, is the ideal destination for those looking to wander off course. It’s the newfound favorite of personalities such as Jacques Grange, Farida Khelfa, François Dumas, the Espírito Santo family, and Madonna, who shares photographs of taking her kids to the beach and horseback riding in the dunes of nearby Carvalhal on weekends. This fishing village boasts swaths of beaches, patchworks of rice paddies, and an ecosystem filled with storks and frogs, all a serene backdrop for the striking homes found there: rustic cabanas and thatched-roof huts reflecting the carefree lifestyle that has become Comporta’s hallmark. This distinctive setting challenges the minds of architects and designers, yielding unique spaces that delightfully blur the line between interior and exterior. Within these pages, the region’s characteristic cobalt blue is reflected from the sky and sea to the walls, shutters, and design pieces that adorn its homes, both picturesque and bold. title: Mykonos Muse Coffee Table Book by Assouline
description: Located in the Cyclades and surrounded by the blue-green water of the Aegean sits whitewashed, windmill-strewn Mykonos, the island of the winds. This ancient island and those surrounding it, mythologized as the bodies of gods felled by Hercules in the time of antiquity, are older than legend and have played host to countless cultures for more than millennia. At forty-square-miles and boasting a population of only ten-thousand, the ‘Ibiza of Greece ’ has become prized for gorgeous architecture, welcoming and open-minded locals, and fantastic beaches. With such names as ‘Paradise’ and ‘Super Paradise,’ the sands of these shores have captured the imaginations and hearts of industry titans, artists, and party-goers alike from all around the globe, marking it as a stable cosmopolitan destination and as a paramount it haven on the jet-set circuit. This travel coffee table book chronicles the culture and society that has defined Mykonos over the past century—from its days as a hideout for such luminaries and elites as Le Corbusier and Antonis Benakis, to its moment as a sanctuary for the gay community,to its predominant party scene—all the while indulging the reader with the ruins and myths hidden there. title: "Play Mahjong!" Hardcover Book
description: Take a deep dive into the culture and strategies of the addictive game of American Mahjong! Mahjong is an intellectually stimulating game of strategy that can sharpen the minds of people of all ages as it brings them together. Play Mahjong! is your comprehensive guide to the American version of the game, packed with interactive step-by-step instructions, helpful tips, tricks, and fun facts designed to enhance your playing experience. This entertaining and immersive look into mahjong also explores the rich history and cultural significance of the game and its ability to build a community among players. Author Alyssa Gross, founder of The Mahjong Society, covers a variety of topics, including: The history and evolution of mahjong The meaning of the tiles and how to set up the game Proper mahjong etiquette Different strategies and ways to play How to read your opponents ...and more! Vibrant colors and eye-catching illustrations make this a beautiful gift book for any mahjong enthusiast. Whether you’re a first-time player or an expert looking to refine your techniques, Play Mahjong! is your companion to mastering mahjong.

title: "The Mahjong Bar" Hardcover Book
description: A playful fusion of delicious drinks and the magic of mahjong, with original cocktails matched to the game's distinctive tiles, suits, honors, and hands. The Mahjong Bar is where the clink of ice meets the clack of tiles. This vibrantly photographed, inventive cocktail book takes you on a journey through the world of mahjong, featuring over 50 drinks (including nonalcoholic options and batch recipes) inspired by the tiles and traditions of the game. Imagine sipping a citrusy Orgeat Orchid as you draw your first tile or mixing a spicy Hot Tile Hot Toddy during a heated hand. Organized into four sections (Cracking Good Cocktails, Match-Perfect Mocktails, Casual Combinations, and Four at the Table: Drinks to Share ) and featuring detailed recipes, garnishing tips, and game-night hosting suggestions, this book is more than a drink guide—it’s an experience. Learn how to craft a variety of delicious cocktails and mocktails for your mahjong nights, including: Eyes-Opening Coffee Martini Bamboo Frappé First Dealer Fizz Lucky Draw Lemonade Float Dead Hand Catechu Cocktail Ready Hand Mimosa Bonus set Bellini Cranberry Crak And more! WHAT ARE ENROBED TILES: Enrobed tiles are surrounded on all edges by a contrasting color from the front and the back of the tiles (sometimes referred to as a "frame"). These tiles are replicas of vintage enrobed tiles which are highly valuable and collectible sets. We are excited to be releasing our Replica Candy Apple Enrobed Mahjong Tiles. These tiles are standard size for National Mah Jongg League play. The front and back of the tiles are a creamy off-white color with a vibrant red frame. They are made of acrylic. HOW THE TILES ARE MADE: The process to create enrobed tiles is very time consuming. 1. First, the candy apple red outer frame of the enrobed border is made. 2. The creamy off-white acrylic is poured into the border. 3. Next, the tiles are polished together for ten days. 4. Finally, each tile is polished one by one by hand to create the blank canvas for our designs! NOTE: Only 10% of the tiles made move forward to be used for our Replica Enrobed Tiles! WHAT IS NEW : This release of our Replica Enrobed tiles will be engraved and have our elegant designs used for our Replica Black Enrobed Tiles which we will share when you have your opportunity to purchase.

title: Mahjong is For the Birds written by Gregg Swain and Susan West, Graphic Design by Woody Swain, spiral bound full-color guide
description: Mahjong collectors Gregg Swain and Susan West have teamed up with Woody Swain, a graphic designer (and Gregg’s husband), to produce the first-ever guidebook for vintage Mahjong sets made of Bakelite, Catalin, Lucite, Chinese Bakelite, French Ivory, and Pyralin. Every day, very costly mistakes are made by buyers and sellers who have no idea of a set’s value. Mahjong is For the Birds will change all that. It will help Mahjong owners determine what kind of set they have, and begin to ascertain its value. Although there are no prices in the guide – the market is very fluid and much depends on the condition of the tiles and accessories – it will instruct people on the relative rarity, and thus desirability of the sets, without going out of date. Given that sets can sell from between $75 to several thousand dollars, this guide is a must-have for anyone with an interest in identifying the sets that they own and buying, selling, collecting, or appraising vintage sets made of materials like Bakelite. This is a large over 120-page full-color, laser-printed guidebook with a coil spine and measures 11" x 9".

WHAT ARE ENROBED TILES: Enrobed tiles are surrounded on all edges by a contrasting color from the front and the back of the tiles (sometimes referred to as a "frame"). These tiles are replicas of vintage enrobed tiles which are highly valuable and collectible sets. We are excited to be releasing the next edition of our Replica Black Enrobed Mahjong Tiles. These tiles are standard size for National Mah Jongg League play. The front and back of the tiles are a creamy off-white color with a black frame. They are made of acrylic. HOW THE TILES ARE MADE: The process to create enrobed tiles is very time consuming. 1. First, the black outer frame of the enrobed border is made. 2. The creamy off-white acrylic is poured into the border. 3. Next, the tiles are polished together for ten days. 4. Finally, each tile is polished one by one by hand to create the blank canvas for our designs! NOTE: Only 10% of the tiles made move forward to be used for our Replica Enrobed Tiles! title: Desert Bloom American Mahjong Tiles by Mod Mahj in Classic White
description: Experience the allure of the Southwest Desert with the Desert Bloom American Mahjong Set by Mod Mahj. This American Mahjong set was designed by Shela Yu, a Chinese American artist born and raised in Mesa, AZ. This beautiful set gives homage to the tradition of Mahjong while blending the imagery of the Arizona desert. The color palette expresses the vibrant colors of the sunsets in the desert as well as the depth of colors found scattered across the land. Shela lovingly designed each suit and piece and describes her choices below. The Bams celebrate the giants of the desert— the saguaro. The one bird bam includes a beloved little cactus wren, commonly seen perched within saguaros. For the Craks, a fun discovery about the origins of the Chinese character “万” (wàn) was utilized. The oracle bone script (ancient Chinese writing) for this character which means ten thousand was symbolic of the scorpion. Scorpions where said to be found in the rocks by the thousands. Given the prevalence of the scorpion in the desert, this felt like a great opportunity to connect Chinese history to this Southwest set. The Dots pay tribute to citrus plants, which have become a staple in the sun drenched Arizona fields. During the peak of citrus seasons, the scent of their fragrant flowers illuminate the air. To be Chinese is to have Dragon mythology baked into your veins. In the desert, there are also numerous mythologies about the rattlesnake from various Native American tribes such as the Tohono O’odham, who originate in Phoenix. In many ways, the rattlesnake feels like the dragon of the desert. The flowers were a great opportunity to highlight the many wonderful plants that our desert has to offer. Included in this set are agave blooms, creosote flowers, desert mallow, desert marigold, desert primrose, desert sage, night blooming cactus, ocotillo flowers, saguaro blooms, and torch flower cactus. Similarly to the flowers, the jokers provided a chance to showcase the plethora of desert animals. Showcased for this set we have bobcat, cow skull, coyote, desert big horn, desert toad, Gila monster, jack rabbit, javelina, roadrunner, and tortoise. The winds were kept fairly simple by maintaining the Chinese characters for the cardinal directions. Complete Set Of 160 Tiles: 36 dots 36 Bams 36 Craks 12 Dragons 16 Winds (N, E, S, W) 10 Flowers 10 Jokers 4 Blanks Tiles 2.54 x 3.65 x 1.11cm

Shela lovingly designed each suit and piece and describes her choices below. The Bams celebrate the giants of the desert— the saguaro. The one bird bam includes a beloved little cactus wren, commonly seen perched within saguaros. For the Craks, a fun discovery about the origins of the Chinese character “万” (wàn) was utilized. The oracle bone script (ancient Chinese writing) for this character which means ten thousand was symbolic of the scorpion. Scorpions where said to be found in the rocks by the thousands. Given the prevalence of the scorpion in the desert, this felt like a great opportunity to connect Chinese history to this Southwest set. The Dots pay tribute to citrus plants, which have become a staple in the sun drenched Arizona fields. During the peak of citrus seasons, the scent of their fragrant flowers illuminate the air. To be Chinese is to have Dragon mythology baked into your veins. In the desert, there are also numerous mythologies about the rattlesnake from various Native American tribes such as the Tohono O’odham, who originate in Phoenix. In many ways, the rattlesnake feels like the dragon of the desert. The flowers were a great opportunity to highlight the many wonderful plants that our desert has to offer. Included in this set are agave blooms, creosote flowers, desert mallow, desert marigold, desert primrose, desert sage, night blooming cactus, ocotillo flowers, saguaro blooms, and torch flower cactus. Similarly to the flowers, the jokers provided a chance to showcase the plethora of desert animals. Showcased for this set we have bobcat, cow skull, coyote, desert big horn, desert toad, Gila monster, jack rabbit, javelina, roadrunner, and tortoise. The winds were kept fairly simple by maintaining the Chinese characters for the cardinal directions. Complete Set Of 160 Cards includes 36 dots 36 Bams 36 Craks 12 Dragons 16 Winds (N, E, S, W) 10 Flowers 10 Jokers 4 Blanks Storage box included

title: MID MOD MAHJ: A whimsical midcentury modern Mahjong tile set
description: THE PRE-ORDER FOR DECEMBER DELIVERY CLOSED ON WEDNESDAY NOV 4 Please add your email to the waitlist to be informed when these tiles are back in stock. How this started: My dear friend Jane (@mahjjane) is a mahjong instructor and taught me Mahjong earlier this year….I almost immediately became OBSESSED. The tiles are so beautiful. The designs, the delicious ASMR of them clacking together - sometimes I just dig my hands into a big bag of tiles to hear them clack around! And don’t even get me started on the mats and the dice trays…. As I kept playing, I got a little tired of looking at mahjong tiles that look too much alike. But at the same time, I’m turned off by designs that are just printed on instead of engraved, tiles that don’t have the right “heft” when you hold them in your hand, and tiles that might have a cool theme to start …but the theme falls apart halfway through the execution. Because as anyone who knows me knows, I. LOVE. A. THEME. And I commit to the bit. I have a habit of taking things I love to do in my LEISURE time and turning them into creative endeavors and JOBS. I’m exhausting to live with. So naturally, I designed my own set of tiles. Though my interior decorating work spans many aesthetics, there was no question as to which aesthetic my first tile set would honor. About the set: MID MOD MAHJ is a completely original mahjong set inspired by the aesthetic I love most: midcentury modern (aka “mid mod”) design, ridiculously good furniture, weird little objects, bold graphics, and the general belief that everything is better with a little more teak. I first lived in a mid-mod house in California: when I was in high school my family rented an Eichler. I lovvvvved the floor plan, the heated floors, the casement windows, and that the whole back of the house was composed of sliding glass doors leading to a central courtyard with a Japanese maple (and a squirrel who would eat out of our hands). ACRYLIC 36mm x 26mm x 15mm (aka 1.42” tall) Engraved and UV printed for durability And it wouldn’t be me if there weren’t little “easter eggs” (nods to design icons, visual puns, and a heavy dose of whimsy). This is the kind of set where you might discover something new about it every time you play. FREE SHIPPING FOR THE CONTIGUOUS 48 UNITED STATES has been included in the cost. Folks from Alaska & Hawaii: Please go ahead and place your order; you should see an option to pay a shipping surcharge for outside the continental U.S. at checkout. If you don’t, never fear. I will invoice you for the difference. Non-U.S.: To simplify things for tax and accounting purposes, at least for this first sale, I will not be selling to customers outside the United States. Please accept my apologies for the inconvenience. Estimated delivery: December 15. I am paying triple the usual freight to have them sent by air (instead of slow boat across the ocean). But lots can change with international trade, so if that changes I will let everyone who ordered know ASAP. I’m on Insta and FB; it’s @oddbirdhome in both places.

title: 2026 International Mahjong Card
description: Say hello to the 2026 International Mahjong Card (IMC) — your go-to guide for modern Mahjong play. Designed to bring unity and clarity to the game, the International Mahjong Card is perfect for every player, including those with color-vision differences, ensuring that Mahjong is accessible to all. In creating this card, we set out to bring together the very best elements of global Mahjong traditions. We drew inspiration from Wright-Patterson’s revered publication , released every five years, giving a nod to terminals 11’s and 99’s , and one day hope to incorporate their beloved flower bouquet bonus — awarding extra points for numbered 1–4 flowers. At the same time, we’ve honored signature aspects of Riichi play from Japan , as well as the classic Pungs and Chows found in traditional Chinese Mahjong. The result is a thoughtfully blended card that celebrates Mahjong’s rich cultural heritage and unites players across styles and borders. Ordering is simple, shipping is reliable, and our friendly support team is always just an email away. You’ll find helpful FAQs on our website and a dedicated Facebook page for real-time updates and community discussions. For today’s players using blanks and modern variations, the IMC serves as a trusted standard — bringing everyone together with one consistent way to play. The International Mahjong Card will be released annually at the beginning of each year. Orders placed now will begin shipping after January 2, 2026 , complete with tracking and easy-to-reach customer service. Best of all, 15% of every sale goes directly to charities that support Alzheimer’s research, awareness, and the search for a cure — a cause close to our hearts. The future of Mahjong starts here. You will also receive a electronic copy of the card immediately, your physical card will ship out soon after your purchase it complete. Dimensions: 18.375 (18 3/8) X 4.75 (4 3/4) when open

title: 2027 International Mahjong Card

description: A new year of play is here with the 2027 International Mahjong Card (IMC) —thoughtfully updated with more lines, an improved layout, and a new beginner section designed to support players as they learn, grow, and play. At its heart, the International Mahjong Card celebrates the rich traditions and global influences that have shaped Mahjong. The IMC draws inspiration from elements of Wright-Patterson play , including terminals 11s and 99s, while also honoring aspects of Japanese Riichi Mahjong and the classic Pungs and Chows found in traditional Chinese Mahjong . These influences come together in a modern style of play designed to connect players across generations, experience levels, and Mahjong traditions. Accessibility also remains an important part of the IMC. The card is thoughtfully designed with players in mind, including those with color-vision differences, helping create a more inclusive experience around the table. Whether you are discovering the IMC for the first time or looking forward to a brand-new year of hands, the 2027 International Mahjong Card offers more ways to challenge yourself, build your skills, and enjoy meaningful time around the table. Best of all, 15% of every IMC sale is donated to charities supporting Alzheimer’s research, awareness, and the search for a cure —a cause close to our hearts. title: Royal Imported Club “Perching Pheasant” Pink Triple-Layer Lucite Set
description: Royal Imported Club “Perching Pheasant” Pink Triple-Layer Lucite Set Likely 1966–1970 Bubblegum-pink Lucite, hand-carved pheasants, and coordinating Catalin racks make this Royal Imported Club set an absolute showstopper. Even before we begin piecing together its history, it is easy to understand why these richly detailed mid-century sets remain so sought after by collectors. The interior of the original Bel-Eire imported linen case bears the Royal Imported Club and Depth Control Colorfast markings. Royal was produced by A&L Manufacturing, the Brooklyn company founded by Alphonse and Lucky Lodato that would later become Crisloid. The triple-layer Lucite tiles feature bubblegum-pink backs carved with the design collectors often call the Perching Pheasant. The backs remain remarkably consistent in color, with little to no variation across the set. The deeply engraved and hand-painted tile faces are believed to have been carved in Hong Kong and finished in the United States. During this period, American manufacturers frequently relied upon Hong Kong’s skilled carvers for the intricate characters, birds, and flowers found on imported sets. A&L’s “Colorfast” and “Depth Control” markings referred to the inks and painting process used to fill those carvings. The set originally included six carved jokers and two blanks, which helps us date it to approximately 1966–1970, during the transition to the eight-joker American mah jongg set. DiDi Gallo of Red Coin Mah Jong later transformed the two blanks into beautifully coordinating jokers, giving the set the eight jokers used in modern National Mah Jongg League play. The flower tiles contain some repeated numbers rather than a traditional sequential run. However, all eight flowers are present and fully suitable for NMJL play. The collection includes: • 152 carved tiles • Eight carved jokers, including two later carved by DiDi Gallo • Original Bel-Eire imported linen case • Four Catalin racks with coordinating Catalin “e” stoppers • One pair of dice Approximate Tile size: 21.65 mm × 30.91 mm × 13.22 mm All 152 tiles are playable, with no cracks, chips, loose layers, or damaged carvings. Some Lucite faces show age-related yellowing or discoloration, most noticeable when the tiles are placed side by side. This is common among sets from this period and does not affect play. The case, racks, stoppers, and dice are all in great vintage condition. We cannot confirm whether every accessory was originally sold with these tiles, but the set presents beautifully as a complete vintage collection. description: Royal Depth Control American Beauty Vintage American Mah Jongg Set | White A & L Manufacturing Co., Inc. | Late 1960s–Early 1970s Consider yourself warned: this is the sort of set that gets people into trouble. The American Beauty is a familiar and beloved name among vintage American Mah Jongg collectors, and for good reason. These sets are beautifully made, wonderfully playable, and have just enough variation from set to set to make you start thinking perhaps you need another one. And then another. Made by A & L Manufacturing Co., Inc., American Beauty was proudly marketed as a completely American-made mahjong set. A & L called its material Alite and promoted it as a non-fading material developed to overcome the discoloration found in some earlier plastics. The company also developed what it called its exclusive "Royal Depth Control" process to create deeply embossed, highly polished tiles with greater uniformity. The carving was then hand-painted in multiple colors, including gold. And those tiles really are the stars here. This collection includes 153 original Alite tiles with the crisp white faces, deeply embossed designs, and wonderfully saturated colors that make American Beauty sets so distinctive. Among them are nine original carved Jokers, giving this set everything it needs for modern American Mah Jongg play, with original tiles to spare. ABOUT THOSE FLOWERS One of our favorite things about this particular set is its wonderful assortment of original flower tiles. American Beauty sets were produced with several different flower runs, including vases, seasons, and maidens. Somewhere along the way, a previous steward of this set appears to have chosen their favorite eight flowers for regular play. What remains with the playable set is one complete original run of four flower vases, along with four additional flowers selected from the vase, season, and maiden designs. We also found three orphaned original flower tiles from another run and have added them to the collection. For someone who plays other forms of mahjong, or simply enjoys studying the wonderful variations found in vintage sets, they're a particularly fun addition. It was not unusual for extra tiles that weren't needed for someone's regular game to become separated from a set over the decades. They were sometimes given away, made into jewelry, tucked into drawers, or simply lost to time. A LITTLE PIECE OF ITS PLAYING HISTORY Tucked inside the case when we found it was a very well-loved 1985–86 National Mah Jongg League card. At some point, someone appears to have cut the card, perhaps to make it fit into a sleeve, and later taped it back together. It's rough. It certainly isn't valuable ephemera. And we're leaving it exactly where we found it. That little card tells us something the tiles alone cannot: years after this set was made, someone was still sitting down with it and playing American Mah Jongg. We think that's worth preserving. title: Royal Games Burgundy Dovetail Catalin Mah Jongg Set
description: Royal Games Burgundy Dovetail Catalin Mah Jongg Set Circa 1950s There are handsome mah jongg sets, and then there are sets that make even seasoned collectors lean a little closer. This rare Royal Burgundy Dovetail is one of them. Its lemon-yellow faces and deep burgundy backs are joined in true dovetail construction, creating a crisp ribbon of contrasting color around every tile. The technique takes its name from the tapered, interlocking joint resembling a dove’s tail. Early bone-and-bamboo tiles relied upon dovetail joinery for function. Here, Royal translated that old-world construction into Catalin largely for beauty, and did it exceptionally well. Dovetail tiles were produced by other manufacturers, but Royal’s examples are particularly admired within the vintage dealer community for their precision and finish. Achieving clean, consistent joints in cast phenolic material required considerable skill. This was not an ordinary production shortcut. It was expensive, exacting work used to create a true luxury set. Catalin itself was something special. Developed during the colorful plastics revolution of the 1920s, it offered brilliant, lustrous shades that traditional Bakelite could not. Unlike injection-molded plastics, Catalin was cast and slowly cured, producing the density, warmth, and polish collectors still prize today. By the postwar years, however, Catalin was becoming increasingly uncommon in consumer goods. Phenolic resins had been redirected toward military needs during World War II, while Lucite, acrylic, and other newer plastics were reshaping American manufacturing. Royal’s use of two contrasting colors, joined tile by tile in the demanding dovetail style, makes this surviving set especially remarkable. The 152 original tiles include 16 flowers, a reminder that this set predates the joker’s full adoption into National Mah Jongg League play. Eight remain flowers, while eight have been designated as jokers with removable stickers made by the late Charli, the well-known and beloved producer of vintage mah jongg tile stickers. This allows the collection to retain all of its original tiles while remaining ready for modern American mah jongg play. The artwork is heat-stamped rather than carved. A heated die impressed each design into the Catalin, producing the smooth, remarkably uniform characters and motifs associated with sets of this period. The collection includes: • 152 original Catalin tiles • Eight original flowers • Eight additional original flowers fitted with removable Charli joker stickers • Hard-to-find Royal “tweed” case • Four Catalin racks in classic 1950s Royal colors • Coordinating Catalin “e” stoppers • One pair of vintage dice Tile count: 152 Tile size: 21.97 mm × 31.18 mm × 12.58 mm The tiles are in beautiful vintage condition overall. There are no cracks, warping, loose joints, damaged impressions, or significant paint loss. One Red Dragon has a small chip on its face. The chip does not reach the side or compromise the dovetail joint, and it has not interfered with play in our groups. It is fully disclosed and clearly shown in the photographs. Because even a small difference can identify a tile during play, the listing photographs also show the chipped Red Dragon face down beside another tile. Its back does not reveal it within the wall or a player’s hand. The rare Royal tweed case is in great vintage condition. Its edges show some wear, but the case remains handsome, structurally sound, and fully functional. The racks, Catalin “e” stoppers, and vintage dice are also in great vintage condition. We do not have this set’s individual provenance, nor can we confirm whether every accessory began its life with these particular tiles. What we can say is that Royal dovetail construction is recognized and highly prized within the vintage dealer world, and examples of this quality are extraordinarily difficult to find. Rich burgundy, sunny lemon yellow, a wonderful tweed case, and 152 original tiles joined with astonishing precision. It is rare, beautifully preserved, completely playable, and just whimsical enough to remind us that exceptional craftsmanship does not have to take itself too seriously. Vintage mah jongg sets were created for play, and a well-loved set will naturally carry patina, gentle wear, and small reminders of the people who gathered around it. We do not consider those signs of age to be imperfections. They are part of the set’s character and continuing story. title: Monobridge/Rottgames “Soaring Sparrow” Pumpkin Catalin Mah Jongg Set
description: Monobridge/Rottgames “Soaring Sparrow” Pumpkin Catalin Mah Jongg Set Likely 1920s–1930s The color alone makes this set remarkable. Over nearly a century, its Catalin tiles have developed a rich pumpkin patina that gives the entire collection a warm, unmistakably vintage presence. Often described by collectors as the Soaring Sparrow pattern for its distinctive One Bam, this set belongs to a family of early American mah jongg tiles frequently attributed to either Monobridge or Rottgames. The two makers used remarkably similar artwork, including a signature One Dot and related flower designs, and unmarked examples remain a source of spirited debate among collectors. Monobridge is generally thought to be the earlier manufacturer or distributor, known for its high-quality Bakelite and Catalin sets. Rottgames, associated with William Rott, later produced mah jongg sets and combination game cases featuring many of the same design elements. Because neither name appears on this case, we are presenting the attribution cautiously as Monobridge/Rottgames. The set includes all 144 original tiles. Eight well-matched orphan tiles have been added and fitted with joker stickers, bringing the set to the 152 tiles needed for modern American mah jongg play. The additions blend remarkably well in color, size, and age and will be shown face down with the original tiles in the listing photographs. Unlike hand-carved tiles, these designs were heat-stamped using a heated die that impressed the artwork directly into the Catalin. This process produced smooth, recessed designs with exceptional consistency across matching tiles. The collection includes: • 144 original Catalin tiles • Eight well-matched orphan tiles with joker stickers • Original case with fitted tile trays • Four burgundy marbled Mah-Lowe racks • One pair of dice Tile size: 21.86 mm × 31.31 mm × 12.07 mm The tiles are in excellent playable condition with no cracks, chips, warping, damaged impressions, or significant paint loss. They are solid Catalin rather than layered tiles. The four burgundy marbled racks are stamped Mah-Lowe. Their metal ends show age-related pitting, which is frequently seen on surviving examples, but all four racks remain stable, functional, and free of sharp edges. The original faux-leather case is structurally sound but shows extensive cosmetic wear. Much of the underlying wood structure is visible along one side. The handle, hinges, lining, and fitted tile trays remain functional. It is a good original case that has simply lived a long and well-used life. We do not know this set’s individual ownership history or whether the Mah-Lowe racks were originally paired with the tiles. What remains is a beautiful, fully playable example from the early boom years of American mah jongg, complete with extraordinary pumpkin-colored Catalin and one of the most recognizable sparrows in vintage tile collecting.

title: Royal Games Green-Dovetail Catalin American Mah Jongg Set
description: Royal Games Green-Dovetail Catalin American Mah Jongg Set Likely Late 1940s Some sets tell you exactly where they’ve been. Others leave just enough mystery to spark the imagination. This extraordinarily rare Royal Games set is one of those. Likely produced in the late 1940s, it represents an important period in the evolution of American Mah Jongg. The set includes 152 original Catalin tiles. During this era, there were as many as 20 flowers included in a set. The eight joker tiles are eight repurposed flower tiles with “CHarli” stickers applied. The National Mah Jongg League did not adopt the eight-joker standard until 1968. It is a common modification today to sticker additional tiles to make vintage sets playable for the modern American game. One of my favorite details is the dovetailed construction of the tiles, intentionally echoing the bone and bamboo sets that dominated Mah Jongg’s first great popularity during the 1920s and 1930s. The backs are a beautiful, consistent green, while the faces have mellowed into a rich egg-yolk yellow that only time can create. The original case remains in remarkably good condition for its age and retains its original leather handle. I believe the Catalin racks are original to the set as well. At some point, the metal chip holders on the ends of the racks were removed, but the Catalin “E” end pieces were thoughtfully retained. Many players actually prefer this arrangement because it makes pushing the wall a little easier during play without the additional length of the metal coin holders.metal t. Specifications • Manufacturer: Royal Games • Era: Likely late 1940s • Tile Count: 152 original Catalin tiles • Tile Size: 1.22” high × 0.863” wide × 0.50” deep (shown in listing photos with a digital caliper) • Tile Construction: Dovetailed Catalin • Tile Color: Green backs with egg-yolk yellow faces • Jokers: Eight stickered jokers included • Ready for NMJL play • Original case with leather handle • Likely original Catalin racks • Original dice included Condition This is a vintage set that has been played, enjoyed, and cared for over many decades. • No evidence of warping or shrinkage. • All racks sit flat. • Case latch functions properly. • Original leather handle remains intact. • One 5 Bam tile has a small chip on the face. In my opinion, it does not affect play. • The racks have a few small chips consistent with age and use. I do my best to photograph and disclose every notable condition issue so there are no surprises. Vintage Mah Jongg sets were made to be played. They develop patina, small imperfections, and honest signs of use that reflect decades spent around the table with family and friends. Those marks are not flaws to me—they’re part of the story. If you’re searching for a factory-perfect set, this probably isn’t the one for you. But if you appreciate craftsmanship, history, and the privilege of becoming the next steward of a remarkable American Mah Jongg set, I think you’ll find this Royal to be something truly special.

title: Wayfinder Mahjong Shuffler
tags: Mahjong Shufflers
description: Think of these as the finishing touch. The earrings that pull the outfit together. The throw pillows that make the room feel done. Our Mahjong shufflers are a small detail that makes a lasting impact. Designed to complement the rest of your table, they bring polish and intention to a moment that’s usually overlooked. E ach piece features a discreet cutout, allowing it to be hung on a hook when not in use , transforming it from a functional object into a sculptural accent within your space, always within reach, yet never adding visual clutter to the table. There is often concern that shufflers can damage mahjong tiles. In reality, mahjong tiles are designed to withstand far more abrasion than a shuffle . Each Haus of Tiles tile is tumbled for days during production, a finishing process that polishes the surface and smooths the edges through continuous motion and contact. This controlled tumbling exposes the tiles to far more friction than they will ever experience during normal play. When used as intended, shufflers support the rhythm of the game while preserving the integrity and beauty of the tiles. Functional, yes. But also beautiful, tactile, and unmistakably Haus of Tiles. Because even the shuffle deserves to be done in style.

title: Joy Book
tags: book, books, Books & Games, Less than $50
description: 7x8in 160 pages A luminous four-color collection of prose and paintings that reveals how joy—quiet, fleeting, and often overlooked—persists, even in the darkest of times, from the critically acclaimed artist and bestselling author of Women Holding Things, Still Life with Remorse, and Sara Berman’s Closet. In this beautiful, inviting, and uplifting book, beloved artist and author Maira Kalman offers a deep appreciation of joy. A timely counterpart to Still Life with Remorse, this four-color collection of original paintings and prose celebrates daily observations of small, unexpected moments of light piercing through the darkness. In a world marked by grief and uncertainty, Kalman believes that seeking joy brings meaning to life. A woman applying red lipstick at a café in Paris after lunch. The intoxicating scent of freshly cut grass in Central Park. A berry tart shared by family in the countryside. Kalman invites readers to experience the world through her eyes, opening the mind and senses to find pleasure, humor, and hope in the everyday. title: International Mahjong Card

description: In creating this card, we set out to bring together the very best elements of global Mahjong traditions. title: Ice Blue & Brights Travel Mahjong Set

description: By Fern Bernstein Join Fern and a colorful cast of characters in her debut memoir titled Mah Jongg Mondays. title: Mah Jongg: The Art of the Game
tags: ambassadornocommission, shopmy0%
description: By Ann Israel and Gregg Swain Mah Jongg: The Art of the Game is the first book to fully capture the story of the exotic and exciting game of Mah Jongg, offering an intimate look at the history of the game as well as the visual beauty of the tiles. When authors Ann Israel and Gregg Swain began playing Mah Jongg, they were unaware of the vintage collections that existed not only in the United States but also in places as far-ranging as Africa to New Zealand. Slowly, they started to collect their own Mah Jongg sets, and as their collections grew, so did their appreciation of the history of, and interest in, the game. Finding few references, Israel and Swain set out to create a book that chronicles the early beginnings of the game and documents Mah Jongg sets and accouterments from the most basic, made simply of paper, to some of the most opulent sets made of precious materials. Recognized and respected scholars and game experts have collaborated with Israel and Swain, contributing important chapters on the game’s history and its pieces. Lastly, great collectors from around the globe have shared their incredible sets and memories for the first time in one book for everyone to enjoy. With hundreds of beautiful new images by renowned photographer, Michel Arnaud, and including historical documentation and ephemera, Mah Jongg: The Art & History of the Game fills the void between the past and today’s game, providing vision, inspiration, and resources. Anyone who has ever been intrigued by a Mah Jongg tile will find in these pages visually stunning photographs that will entice them into becoming an enthusiast of the timeless game of Mah Jongg. Authors: Ann Israel grew up in Detroit and now lives in New York City. She has been writing Advice for the Lawlorn, a weekly syndicated column for attorneys published by American Law Media since 1994. Gregg Swain, a graduate of Smith College with a Major in Art History, grew up in New York City where she nurtured her love of art. She earned a Doctorate in Clinical Psychology. This is her first book. Photographer: Michel Arnaud’s work has appeared in countless books and magazines.

description: Now in its 3rd edition, available in English or Spanish. Please select your language before adding to cart. The American Mahjong guide you’ll actually use at the table. There are plenty of ways to learn American Mahjong. This is the one we wanted sitting next to us while we play. Our American Mahjong Play Guide is a comprehensive, beautifully illustrated reference to the game, written by Tigre de Tartán partner Caroline Larew . Caroline brings an unusual combination of brains to the subject: a Stanford MBA, years spent teaching American Mahjong, and, before all of that, a stint in improv theater. The result is a guide that understands both the rules and how to explain them to an actual human being. Everything is organized to be quickly understood and, more importantly, quickly found again when 4 people at the table have 4 different opinions. Inside you’ll find the full structure of American Mahjong, including how to read the NMJL card, dealing, the Charleston, turn-taking and game flow, calling and exposing tiles, and completing a winning hand. And then there is the spiral. The 5" × 7" spiral-bound format lies completely flat , because a reference book that keeps closing itself while you’re trying to play is not particularly useful. Leave it open beside your rack, flip directly to what you need, or tuck it into your mahjong bag when you’re finished. It’s comprehensive enough to learn from, concise enough to reference during play, and beautiful enough that we don’t mind it living permanently on the table. There is a reason this has become one of our best-selling little books. En Español (see details below) Our Spanish edition was translated by Adriana “Nanis” Treviño of MTY Mahjong Club in Monterrey, Mexico , with the vocabulary of the game carefully adapted for Spanish-speaking players. Details 3rd edition Comprehensive reference for American Mahjong Written for play using current NMJL rules Spiral-bound to lie flat at the table Compact 5" × 7" format, 33 pages Clear, illustrated and easy to navigate Useful for new players, returning players and the inevitable rules dispute Written by Tigre de Tartán partner Caroline Larew Available in English and Spanish AHORA TAMBIÉN EN ESPAÑOL Nuestra Guía de Juego de Mahjong Americano , ahora en su tercera edición, también está disponible completamente en español. Creada para aprender y consultar mientras juegas, esta guía explica el Mahjong Americano de manera clara y completa, desde cómo leer la tarjeta de la NMJL y repartir las fichas hasta el Charleston, los turnos, las exposiciones y cómo completar una mano ganadora. El formato compacto de 5" × 7" con encuadernación en espiral se mantiene completamente abierto sobre la mesa , para que puedas consultar una regla rápidamente sin interrumpir el juego. Es completa para quien está aprendiendo, práctica para tener junto a tu atril y lo suficientemente bonita como para dejarla sobre la mesa. La misma guía que nuestros clientes conocen y usan, ahora en español.
